questions: 第 1 題：The technician ____ repairs the scanners is away this week. (A) whose (B) who (C) which (D) where
第 2 題：The access badge ____ Omar found beside the printer belongs to a visitor. (A) whom (B) where (C) which (D) whose
第 3 題：Please contact the supplier ____ invoice lists an incorrect delivery address. (A) whom (B) which (C) whose (D) where
第 4 題：The depot ____ the drivers collect their route sheets opens at six. (A) which (B) whose (C) whom (D) where
第 5 題：The depot ____ the company leased for its new vehicles opens at six. (A) which (B) where (C) whose (D) who
第 6 題：Our safety manual, ____ includes a map of the exits, is available at reception. (A) that (B) whose (C) which (D) where
logic: 1 technician person, repairs lacks subject:who. that also valid defining alternative outside options. whose lacks noun, which not this person, where not subject.
2 Omar subject, found lacks directobjectbadge:which. defining that/omission also valid outside options. whom person,where location,whose possessive not needed.
3 supplier owns invoice;invoice subjectlists,whose supplies possession. whom/which/where do not form intended supplier-invoice possession.
4 drivers collect route sheets complete core,where adds depot location. which alone lacks suitable subject/object gap,whose+the drivers not possessive phrase here,whom person/no role.
5 company leased lacks objectdepot,which. forvehicles purpose not directobject. defining that/omission also valid outside options;where cannot fill object,whose/who not intended role.
6 comma nondefining manual,includes needs subjectwhich. that disallowed in this type,whose lacks noun,where cannot subject. No omission.
rewrites: sensors which Lena calibrated -> sensors Lena calibrated,defining object omission valid; extra them duplicates object.
technician who calibrated sensors:who subject cannot simply delete into ordinary complete sentence.
screens that needrepair restrict reference but do not entail other healthy screens; screens,which needrepair, adds information about alreadyidentified screens.
